name: Matched Maximum Paths with Nonample Product
definition: On the same two shared coordinates take the maximum paths $P_{\nearrow}=\{00,10,11\}$ and $P_{\searrow}=\{00,01,11\}$. With no private coordinates, their coordinate fiber product is their intersection $\{00,11\}$.
properties: Both inputs are rank-one maximum and ample. The two-word output shatters each singleton coordinate but contains no one-dimensional cube, so it is not ample. This shows that the one-coordinate product theorem cannot be extended to arbitrary shared blocks.
